name: cudafast-muse-glimmer-30b
description: Muse Glimmer 30B NVFP4 CUDA text inference speedup track on DGX Spark (GB10, sm_121). Target: nvidia/Muse-Glimmer-30B-NVFP4 @ 47818374517751c48c55cde2621594926b1888b6, a ModelOpt MIXED_PRECISION checkpoint (213 layers W4A16_NVFP4 group 16, 180 layers FP8 w8a8, vision tower in BF16) of a 52-layer text decoder: 39 sliding-attention layers (window 2048) and 13 full-attention layers, dense MLP (intermediate 19968), hidden 6656, vocab 202048. The engine is vLLM v0.27.1, its Python package VENDORED at vllm/ and layered over the pinned container's compiled extensions; the scored binary is the Engine Protocol v1 adapter (harness/protocol-adapter) attached to one vLLM resident per leg (harness/vllm_resident). The track is SERIAL ONLY: allowed_modes is [serial], the checkpoint ships no MTP tensors and no speculative arm is scored. The target quantization is frozen. Scoring is single-stream and paired with a per-box baseline: 3 pairs of one serial-control leg on the reference tree and one candidate leg, one pair per prompt of the fixture's live_goldens (three organizer prompts of 512 tokens, one unmeasured prefill warm-up pass, 128-step decode); composite = prefill_gain^0.25 * decode_gain^0.75 for each pair, where decode is the decode window (decode-run time / N, no seed prefill); the score is the mean of the 3 per-pair composites, floors 0.95 on every pair, decode ceiling 5.0, prefill ceiling 2.0. fixtures/muse_glimmer_30b_cuda_v1_track.json is the authority; editablePaths is the authority for what a submission may change.
